title: How many estimates were right?
hook: Two stated cases: explore the denominator in a reported accuracy share.

knows: Reading the stated arithmetic assumptions and a small numerical chart
doesNotKnow: How the denominator in a reported accuracy share affects the stated comparison

misconception: The headline alone determines Accuracy, regardless of the stated inputs.
objective: Compare the denominator in a reported accuracy share in two explicit finite cases; separate model arithmetic from an empirical population claim.
keyState: Both question and changed cases computed; both parameter/result witnesses retained.
